question: What majestic selfhood and cosmic temporal abode define the divine?
premises: The divine is addressed as the majestic self.
The divine is addressed as the abode of world and time.
inference: The divine is honored as a majestic self and as the locus of cosmic time.
uncertainties: jagat-kāla-sthālāya may be parsed in more than one way.
plain_english: Obeisance to the majestic self, obeisance to the abode of the world and time.
